definitions.explanation: Financial or moral support given to help an organization, event, or cause. Often used in the context of membership or sponsorship of associations.

examples.japanese: {賛助|さんじょ}{会員|かいいん}を{募集|ぼしゅう}しています。
{企業|きぎょう}から{賛助|さんじょ}{金|きん}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: We received sponsorship funding from a company.

examples.japanese: このイベントは{多|おお}くの{団体|だんたい}の{賛助|さんじょ}によって{実現|じつげん}した。
examples.english: This event was made possible through the support of many organizations.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly seen in {賛助|さんじょ}{会員|かいいん} (supporting member/associate member), a common membership category in Japanese organizations where members provide financial support without full voting rights.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賛助|さんじょ}{会員|かいいん} (supporting member)
- {賛助|さんじょ}{金|きん} (sponsorship money)
- {賛助|さんじょ}{出演|しゅつえん} (guest appearance in support)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後援|こうえん}: patronage, backing — broader support, often for events
- {協賛|きょうさん}: co-sponsorship — joint support, often commercial
